tagline.zh-CN: 将提交记录与已合并 PR 提炼为清晰的双语 Changelog 与升级指南。
tagline.en: Turns commit logs and merged PRs into crisp bilingual release notes and upgrade guides.

description.zh-CN: 自动区分用户可见新功能、缺陷修复、破坏性变更与升级步骤，拒绝堆砌内部提交哈希；可选联动 GitHub、Linear 与 Jira 拉取发版上下文。
description.en: Groups merged changes into user-facing highlights, bug fixes, breaking changes, and upgrade steps instead of raw git log dumps. Optionally connects to GitHub, Linear, or Jira.
